Options/RSUs can change fully diluted equity value.

Both earnings and equity represent the integrated/packaged-meat group, not its hog-farming segment.
A single event is not a US-industry historical percentile.

scenario_demonstrations.status: Method demonstration only; not calibrated forecasts, not approved application defaults, no probability weights.
important_limits: To isolate duration, arithmetic uses the earlier constant alpha/k shorthand, including negative years. Applying k=0.8 and alpha=0.95 to losses reduces cash losses and is not conservative.
The production calculator should replace that shorthand with explicit NI+D&A-capex-deltaNWC+net borrowing and handle negative cash/financing/dilution.
All three paths intentionally converge to the same terminal margin for a fair operating-path comparison; test terminal margins separately.
A positive perpetual gap is a hypothesis about retained efficiency/rent; it is not an economic hard floor.

coverage_limitations: No verified decade-long matched prices and common share counts for Seaboard/Tyson/Hormel, so historical PE series are null.
Smithfield was private through 2024; no 2015–2024 public equity PE exists for that issuer.
Historical companyfacts observations use latest restatements available at the cut-off, not a point-in-time backtest data set.
Fiscal year calendars, business mix, subsidiary scope and accounting policies differ.
Observed loss frequency in selected companies and years is not an independently identified probability of a future Muyuan scenario.
